text.en: Most dog owners praise trainers Angel and Alexis for their patience, clear explanations, and hands-on guidance. Pet parents appreciate the comprehensive multi-hour transition sessions at pick-up, where handlers demonstrate techniques and coach families on continuing progress at home. Reviewers describe trainers who genuinely understand canine behaviour.

Clients frequently report dramatic improvements in stubbornness, leash manners, and off-leash recall after the multi-week boarding programmes. Pet parents of high-energy or reactive puppies note calmer temperaments in public spaces and at home. While one reviewer felt the progress did not justify the cost, most describe lasting behavioural transformations.

Pet owners consistently commend the frequent progress updates delivered throughout the boarding stay. Reviewers highlight receiving regular written report cards along with photos and video demonstrations showing their dogs mastering new commands. Families emphasize that these ongoing updates provided reassurance while separated from their pets.

q.en: Does Camp Lucky provide board and train programmes in San Antonio?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently enrol dogs in two-week and three-week immersive board and train courses.

q.en: Do trainers send progress updates during training?

a.en: Yes, reviewers consistently mention receiving regular report cards accompanied by photos and training videos.

q.en: Is there a handover session after the boarding programme?

a.en: Yes, pet parents report in-depth transition sessions lasting several hours to demonstrate commands and guide owners.

q.en: Can owners train reactive or anxious dogs here?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight successful behavioural modification for dogs with severe reactivity and high energy.
